reading.action: Stand, take up the iron bar, channel Ember essence out through it to concentrate heat at the tip (first deliberate channel — manifests the skill)
reading.result: MODEST SUCCESS — Ember Channel emerged by deed (active essence-skill, rank I per affinity-system). Iron bar's tip heated to a sustained dull ember-glow; nascent = limited intensity, no open flame, costs Focus to hold. Focus 74->62. Bar now carries a heat quality for strikes. No backlash (controlled outward channel, unlike the raw draw).
